subject: GovCloud AMI listing: compliance claims and evidence for product page
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GovCloud AMI listing: compliance claims and evidence for product page

Team —

ACME's procurement and the AWS partner team flagged that we need a GovCloud-specific product page copy plus a short evidence matrix that ties our AMI/packaging claims to artifacts (SOC2 snapshot, AMI bake process, encryption-at-rest docs). They want the material before they kick off the procurement review (goal: next Monday).

Ask: can someone take the lead on (1) a one-paragraph product description for the AWS GovCloud listing that mentions regional eligibility and any limitations, and (2) a compact claims->evidence matrix (single sheet) we can share with AWS and ACME procurement?

Notes:
- Keep the product copy explicit about what we do NOT support in GovCloud (e.g., third-party telemetry forwarding to non-GovCloud endpoints) — ACME is strict about data residency.
- Evidence matrix should map each claim (SOC2, encryption, AMI immutability, KMS integration) to a file or artifact and a short contact for verification.

I can draft the matrix template if helpful; Kimberly, you have the marketplace copy expertise — can you draft the paragraph and pull the current marketplace copy into a GovCloud-safe variant? Rafael, can you pull the bake/AMI packaging notes (and attach the SOC2 snapshot)? Marissa, please stand by for procurement liaison to ACME.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Marketplace & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud AMI listing: compliance claims and evidence for product page

Irene —

Thanks, I'll take the copy. Draft below (keeps claims conservative and explicit about limitations):

--- DRAFT PRODUCT BLURB FOR AWS GOVCLOUD ---
Redwood Inference — GovCloud AMI
Redwood Inference provides an AMI packaged inference runtime optimized for regulated workloads in AWS GovCloud (US). The AMI enables private deployment of our inference engine inside your GovCloud accounts, with support for customer-managed KMS keys, local KV cache only, and no external telemetry by default.

Limitations: The GovCloud AMI does not support cross-region telemetry or routing to non-GovCloud endpoints. Customers requiring hybrid connectivity (GovCloud <-> commercial regions) should contact Redwood to discuss validated network patterns and dataflow safeguards.

Key features: private AMI image, KMS-integrated secrets, documented bake & immutability process, and SOC2 evidence scoped to inference runtime operations.
--- end draft ---

I've kept the wording factual and avoided regulatory assertions (e.g., "FedRAMP"), since we don't have that attestation for this image. If folks want stronger marketing language we should attach legal-approved copy.

Rafael: can you attach the AMI bake checklist and the SOC2 snapshot so I can reference them in the matrix? I'll start a single-sheet matrix in the Drive folder and drop a versioned copy.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-govcloud-evidence (I created a draft folder and gave ACME/partners view).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Content Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-product-copy-v3.md (text)

From: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud AMI listing: compliance claims and evidence for product page

Hi Kimberly / Irene —

Thanks for the quick turn. ACME procurement and our GovCloud listing intake have a couple of follow-ups after reviewing the draft blurb: they need a concise table that maps each marketplace claim to a specific artifact (e.g., SOC2 Attestation PDF, AMI bake script with commit hash, KMS key policy snippet) and a verification contact (name + email).

Two clarifications from ACME:
1) ACME needs to confirm whether the AMI image in GovCloud is rebuilt from scratch in GovCloud accounts (i.e., do you provide a CloudFormation/SAM bake or a pre-baked AMI?), and whether any build steps reference non-GovCloud external services.
2) ACME expects an encryption-at-rest note that references the KMS key model and whether customer-managed keys are supported.

If you can add those specifics to the matrix and share the folder link (or a single PDF) by EOD Friday their sourcing window will remain on track.

Best,
AWS Partner Team (GovCloud intake)
Attachment: none

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud AMI listing: compliance claims and evidence for product page

Kim / Irene / Marissa —

Uploading the artifacts now to the Drive folder. Quick answers inline for ACME/AWS intake:

1) AMI build model: we provide a pre-baked AMI (Redwood-maintained) for GovCloud; the bake pipeline runs entirely within GovCloud build accounts and references only GovCloud-available artifacts (base images, package repos mirrored in GovCloud). The pipeline includes a signed commit hash and a reproducible bake manifest. I attached the bake checklist and the manifest snippet.

2) Encryption: the AMI supports customer-managed KMS keys. The AMI disk volumes are encrypted at rest using EBS encryption with the customer's KMS key; the marketplace listing will call out "Customer-managed AWS KMS keys supported" and reference the KMS policy snippet in the matrix.

Attachments uploaded: govcloud-ami-claim-matrix.xlsx (draft), govcloud-bake-checklist.txt (bake steps + commit hash), soc2-snapshot-2026Q2.pdf. I've noted my contact info in the matrix for verification.

Next steps: Kimberly, please reference the uploaded file in the product page copy and share the single-sheet PDF with AWS/ACME by Friday EOD. Marissa, happy to join the call with ACME procurement if helpful.

-Rafa
Rafael Mendes
Senior DevOps Engineer, Packaging
Redwood Inference

Attachment: govcloud-bake-checklist.txt (text); govcloud-ami-claim-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet); soc2-snapshot-2026Q2.pdf (pdf)
